_doc: AL-75: trade, barter, treats and gifts.
say.trade.offer.buy: I will give {price} {price:plural|coin|coins} for the {get}. Deal?
say.trade.offer.barter: {listener}, let us swap: the {give} for the {get}.
say.trade.offer.gift: {listener}, this is for you. Take the {give}.
say.trade.offer.meal: I would like the {get}, {listener}. Here is {price} {price:plural|coin|coins}.
say.trade.accept.counter: All right, have it your way.
say.trade.gift.like: Oh, the {give}! You guessed it, I love these.
say.trade.gift.neutral: Thanks. It will come in handy.
say.trade.gift.dislike: Well... thanks. I do not care for {give}.
The {give}? Hm. Fine, give it here.
say.trade.treat.dislike: Not my taste, but thank you.
Hm. I will eat it, since you offer.
say.trade.counter.coin: Too little. Add {price} {price:plural|coin|coins} and it is a deal.
say.trade.counter.less: Not that many. Take less: the {get}, and that is it.
For that - only the {get}, no more.
say.trade.refuse.too_little: That is too little for the {get}.
No, {listener}, not like that. Too little.
say.trade.refuse.insult: Are you joking? That, for the {get}?
say.trade.refuse.no_goods: I do not have that much {get}.
say.trade.refuse.no_means: You do not even have the {give}.
And what will you pay with, {listener}?
say.trade.refuse.no_room: I have nowhere to put it.
say.trade.refuse.distrust: I will not deal with you.
say.trade.refuse.enmity: Go away, {listener}. I will not take it.
say.trade.refuse.tired: Enough haggling, {listener}. I am sick of it.
How long will this go on? We are done.
say.trade.refuse.full: I could not eat another bite, {listener}.
say.trade.refuse.dislike: The {give}? I do not like it. No thanks.
Take it away, {listener}, I cannot stand that.
say.trade.refuse.nothing: There is nothing to trade here.
I have nothing to offer you, {listener}.
say.trade.refuse.keeps: The {get} is not for sale, I need it.
say.trade.counter_no: Too dear. I will do without.

trade.weigh: {who} weighs it: gets {gain} coins of worth, gives {loss} (margin ×{keep})
trade.treat_dislike: {who} does not like the treat ({give}): relation {delta}
